title: introduce-incremental-dep-validator-and-lightweight-runner-refactor
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: our CI pipeline has grown heavier over time as dependency checks and full validator runs are gated on every push. This PR introduces an incremental dependency validation step that runs cheap checks on changed dependency metadata and a post-submit stability validator for the full graph. It also refactors the CI runner image into a lightweight 'runner-lite' variant used for fast checks, reducing startup time and image size for ephemeral CI jobs.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds a new CI composite action 'ci/actions/incremental-validate.yml' that inspects lockfile diffs, package manifests, and a cached dependency fingerprint to run focused validations instead of full graph resolution on every PR.
- Adds a post-submit job (nightly and post-merge) that runs the heavyweight dependency-stability validator against the full dependency graph and publishes a report artifact.
- Introduces a small Go-based helper 'tools/dep-validator' (single binary) used in both incremental and post-submit flows for reproducible resolution checks and simple heuristics (license, checksum drift, registry mismatch).
- Refactors our CI runner image into 'ci/actions/runner-lite' (smaller base image, removed optional language runtimes, moved heavy tooling into remote step caches) and updates Makefile.ci to support image variants.
- Adds a TTL-based ephemeral build cache pruner script 'scripts/build-cache-ttl.sh' to avoid unbounded cache growth and reduce long-tail CI flakiness.
- Updates docs with a migration guide 'docs/ci/runner-migration.md' and adds a short dev-facing FAQ about the new incremental checks.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design and acceptance criteria documented in ENG-4281
- [x] Unit tests for the dep-validator helper (basic resolution + checksum checks)
- [x] Integration smoke in a feature pipeline (small repo fixture)
- [x] Migration docs + runbook for rollbacks
- [x] Post-merge nightly job configured and tested

Commits (high level):
- feat(ci): add incremental-validate composite action and small wrapper
- feat(tools): add dep-validator v0.1 with checksum and license checks
- refactor(ci): introduce runner-lite image + Makefile.ci targets
- chore(scripts): add build-cache-ttl.sh and documentation
- docs: ci/runner-migration.md and faq

Files/areas changed (high level):
- ci/actions/incremental-validate.yml
- ci/actions/postsubmit-dep-stability.yml
- ci/actions/runner-lite/Dockerfile
- Makefile.ci
- tools/dep-validator/*.go
- scripts/build-cache-ttl.sh
- docs/ci/runner-migration.md
- pkg/ci/runner/entrypoint.ts (adjusted to detect runner variant)

Testing notes: 
- Local unit tests for dep-validator run in ~8s.
- End-to-end smoke for incremental flow executed against a small monorepo fixture in CI.
- Postsubmit nightly job validated by running once on a staging branch; result artifact uploaded to artifacts/redwood-dep-stability/2026-02-18.

Review conversation (high level):
- Aisha (review): "Love the idea of incremental checks — two asks: can we make the fingerprint algorithm stable across platforms and ensure the cache key accounts for node/yarn/pnpm differences? Also please add a short explanation of false-positive modes in the docs."
- Maya (author): "Addressed: fingerprint normalized by sorting manifests and canonicalizing macOS / Linux line endings; added explicit cache-key sections in the action and expanded the FAQ about false positives and how to trigger a full run."
- Daniel (review): "Runner image looks much smaller, but we need to be careful about missing runtime pieces when a job intentionally wants the full image. Suggest Makefile.ci provide a clear target to build the full runner."
- Maya: "Added Makefile.ci 'runner:full' and 'runner:lite' targets and documented expected tradeoffs in runner-migration.md."
- Luca (approval): "Verified postsubmit run and artifacts; good to go after CI green."

CI summary: initial push triggered matrix: lint/test/integration. Lint had a transient false-negative fixed by pinning a linter version; subsequent run passed. Integration smoke had an unrelated flakes in the fixture (fixed by increasing wait timeout). Final CI: all checks passed.

Rollout and post-merge: after squash-merge, runner-lite image published to our internal ECR with tag 'runner-lite:2026-02-19', Makefile.ci targets merged, and nightly postsubmit job scheduled. We will monitor the first week for any rise in CI cache misses or post-merge instability (alerts wired to #ci-alerts).

Risks and mitigations: 
- Risk: Incremental validator could miss cross-package conflicts that only appear after full resolution. Mitigation: post-submit full validator and ability to manually trigger full run from the PR UI.
- Risk: Runner-lite may not contain a language runtime needed by rare jobs. Mitigation: clear migration docs and Makefile targets to build the full runner, plus a temporary CI flag to force the full image per job.

Follow-ups (tracked in ENG-4310):
- Expand dep-validator heuristics to include transitive license attribution and vulnerability delta checks.
- Add fine-grained telemetry for incremental hits/misses to measure efficacy and tune the heuristics.
- Explore replacing the TTL-based cache pruner with a usage-based eviction policy.

Merge outcome: Squash-merged by Aisha Patel on 2026-02-19.

release_notes:
- Add incremental dependency validator to reduce full-graph runs on PRs.
- Introduce runner-lite CI image for faster ephemeral jobs.
- Add nightly post-submit dependency stability job and cache pruner script.
- Migration docs for CI runner changes.
notes_for_support: If teams see unexpected dependency breakage after merge, instruct them to trigger the manual full validator via the CI UI and file a ticket referencing ENG-4281. For missing runtime in runner-lite, switch job to use runner:full via Makefile.ci target until job is adapted.
